sourceReview.rationale: Independent heading and block review found no heading named Best Comics or Essential Comics and no complete issue-bearing block under either title. Contrarian checks found those words only in collection titles and scattered prose, which do not qualify as a section. The complete guide, from I) The Captain Marvel / Phil Lawson Years (Origins and Beginnings) through Latest Additions, is therefore the frozen boundary; every explicit numbered issue occurrence is retained in source order, with the owner-authorized non-existent #130 identity recorded as an exclusion.
